name: WaddleVita
author: HoloFlix
description:
Play Club Penguin on your Vita. WaddleVita runs the original Flash game (a modified RuffleVita, built on Ruffle) with Club Penguin controls, and plays it from a Waddle Forever server.

Pick a date on the timeline and the island is the island of that day: rooms, music, clothes, parties and minigames from 2005-08-22 to 2011-06-26. Your penguin is the same on every date.

Two ways to play: from a Waddle Forever server on your PC (the release includes a one-click start script, and the Vita finds it on your Wi-Fi by itself), or completely offline, with the server running on the Vita. Offline mode needs a 1.3 GB pack that you make once on your PC from your own Waddle Forever install (a tool and step-by-step guide are in the release).

The game files are not included: you bring your own Waddle Forever install.
requirements: A homebrew-enabled Vita or PS TV, and Waddle Forever installed on a PC (free, github.com/nhaar/Waddle-Forever) to supply the game files. For offline play, about 1.4 GB free on the memory card.
